notes: Ambient: the music box (Analog Lab 23 Celesta (Arturia): one layer, no beating, sounds at the written octave; Celestia (v6) had a second layer 13 c sharp on the left channel that beat 4-9 Hz, and MUSIC BOX 2 sounds two octaves up. A real music box has no dynamics to speak of, and neither does this preset (about 1 dB over the velocity range). v9 review (MINOR 1): 23 Celesta is near a sine, so box_shine (Analog Lab Full Range Glockenspiel, insert 1) doubles each pluck about 13 dB under it, and the box gets a +6 dB shelf at 2.5 kHz. The glockenspiel sounds an octave above the box on purpose (gate: --octave box_shine=1).
